تجتذبون (form VIII)
# تَجْتَذِبُونَ (tajtaḏibūna) /tad͡ʒ.ta.ði.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
# تُجْتَذَبُونَ (tujtaḏabūna) /tud͡ʒ.ta.ða.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
